description: Answer one stored message, and send the answer now. It goes to the message's Reply-To or From (for your own sent copy, to whoever it went to), from the mailbox that holds it, with a Re: subject, threaded under it. You write only the words; the recipient and mailbox can't change. It goes through every check a send meets (the suppression list, the mailbox's gap and daily cap, the plan's daily sends and, for outside replies from agent inboxes, the agentReplies limit), the same as draft_reply then send_draft, and the reply shows in the conversation as yours. Pass your own intentKey so a retry can never send it twice: the same intentKey with the same words answers the same send, and with other words is refused (422). From an agent inbox it also meets the inbox's rules, which no setting changes: it answers only mail that came in, and only to its From address, ignoring case; a differing Reply-To is refused even at the same domain (409 inboxRepliesOnly); never a message a machine sent, such as an automatic reply, a mailing list, a bounce or a spam report (409 inboxReplyAutomated); only a message whose DMARC check passed, or, for a domain with no DMARC policy, whose SPF or DKIM pass aligns with the From's organizational domain; missing, unaligned, failed or unfinished evidence is refused (409 inboxSenderUnauthenticated); and at most 10 replies into one conversation in 24 hours (429 inboxThreadDay) and 100 a day (429 quotaAgentInboxDay). Every send from an agent inbox carries Auto-Submitted: auto-replied, which asks other machines not to answer it. The reply carries no copies yet. Pass fileIds to attach stored files from a mailbox you connected with its own mail server (409 filesNotFromOurServers on an agent inbox or through our mail servers; 409 messageTooLargeForMailbox past the mailbox's size limit). The answer is the send as reserved: read it with get_send, or watch send.sent, send.failed and send.cancelled. A key without send writes the reply with draft_reply and asks a person with request_draft_review. An owner may limit the API key you call with: to some mailboxes or campaigns, to outreach or transactional email, and to a number of emails a day or in all. Anything outside those limits answers 403 and nothing is sent: `details.scope` names the limit (`keyMailbox`, `keyCampaign`, `keyStream` or `keyTotal`). When the key has sent all its emails for today, it answers 429 with `details.scope: "keyDay"`, `resetAt` and a Retry-After header. A key can't read or change its own limits: ask a workspace owner. New messages and replies to your own sent mail are cold direct outreach. They carry `List-Unsubscribe` and, over HTTPS, `List-Unsubscribe-Post`, with a link for this send's To address. No footer is added. They meet the mailbox's domain grace, health rest and cold ceiling. A refusal names `details.scope`: `mailboxDomain` or `mailboxHealth` (409, `details.resetAt` null), `mailboxColdRest` (409, its fixed end), or `mailboxColdDay` (429, the workspace's midnight and Retry-After). Scheduled promotion checks again; claim stops a rest that began later. Every 15 minutes, 0.1% complaints or 5% bounces over at least 50 cold direct sends in 7 days rests the mailbox for 72 hours. Only sends since the last trip count. `get_mailbox` returns `coldRest` and the visible problem; `mailbox.failed` and `mailbox.recovered` mark the trip and lift. Three automatic pause days in 30 days can restrict the workspace, unless staff pinned its posture. Replies to mail received, tests, transactional mail, warmup and seed do not get these headers or cold gates.

bodyHtml.description: The HTML part of your answer. Send bodyHtml, bodyText or both. The mailbox's signature is added, so leave it out.

bodyText.description: The plain-text part of your answer. Send bodyHtml, bodyText or both. The mailbox's signature is added, so leave it out.

fileIds.description: Stored files to attach, in order, up to 10 ids from create_file or create_file_upload. A repeated id counts once.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

intentKey.description: Your own name for this one message, up to 255 characters. Send the same intentKey again and you get the same send back, never a second email, with no time limit. Names starting with draft:, warmup: or campaign: are refused.
